studentFeatures.title: Play Integrity Security Protection
studentFeatures.description: App communication is cryptographically verified to safeguard your account, seat, and personal data.

studentFeatures.title: Strict Single-Seat Allocation
studentFeatures.description: Accurate real-time seat occupancy ensures only your current assigned seat is locked.

studentFeatures.title: Official Fee Receipts & Rupee Currency
studentFeatures.description: View authentic fee receipts with genuine ₹ symbols and official library verification stamps.

studentFeatures.title: Automated Expiry & Grace Badges
studentFeatures.description: Daily automated expiry tracking with 7-day grace period status badge and 1-tap seat renewal.

adminFeatures.title: Single-Seat Occupancy Enforcement
adminFeatures.description: Reassigning or moving a student automatically frees their prior seat, preventing duplicate occupied seats.

adminFeatures.title: Real-Time Revenue Aggregation
adminFeatures.description: Instant financial tracking without dataset limits or pagination caps. Running totals updated on every payment.

adminFeatures.title: Firebase Play Integrity App Check

adminFeatures.title: Daily Automated Expiry Checks
